findings.issue: Two `rw` chains append long tails of trivial arithmetic lemmas to the one substantive integral rewrite, so an upstream rename of any of `sub_zero`/`smul_eq_mul`/`mul_one`/`mul_assoc`/`add_neg_cancel`/`exp_zero` breaks the proof.

summary: Proofs are generally well-commented and use robust automation (congr_deriv + linear_combination, nlinarith with explicit hints, positivity), but a reusable nonnegativity fact is buried inside photonFluxProfile_pos, one hypothesis package is duplicated verbatim, and two IsEquivalent steps retype functions by bare rfl across Pi.mul_apply/Function.const where the same file elsewhere does it explicitly.
